scope: Only when the current maximum candidate price is within the declared complete bank cap, enumerate complete proper masks containing an uncovered pivot, disjoint from used, and with at most d points outside free. Other cases retain the original Extend generator.
regional_prefilter: Candidate cost cannot exceed its initial maximum, and initial mother-union occupancy cannot exceed initial d; d only decreases. Thus fixed per-frame region filtering removes no possible future class.
pivot_rule: When every remaining size/maximum price is bank-covered, choose an uncovered point with fewest compatible columns. Zero such columns is infeasible. Otherwise use the original pivot.
